error[TypeError]: Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions
 --> case.js:4:11
  |
4 | const t = fee * BigInt(2) + cost(items[0]);
  |           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ `fee * BigInt(2)` is a BigInt but `cost(items[0])` is a Number; arithmetic needs both to be the same type
  |
  = help: make both BigInt: `fee * BigInt(2) + BigInt(cost(items[0]))`
  = help: or make both Number (precision is lost above 2^53): `Number(fee * BigInt(2)) + cost(items[0])`
  = stack: <top-level> (case.js:4)
